responsibilities.description: Keeps ice sessions in memory. It can register a new session under a generated identifier, look a session up by id, save changes to one, and list all sessions.

responsibilities.description: Returns the sessions whose date falls within an inclusive date range, sorted by date and then by start time. This gives a schedule view used for reporting.
